requirements.requirement: Record the actual HEAD and preserve unknown/uncommitted work; rebase decisions are explicit, not automatic.
Historical evaluation and receipt trees are fingerprinted and unchanged after bootstrap.
Runtime network, model-budget and local-action policy default to no external access/no new provider calls.
Baseline checks are executed where available; unavailable checks remain not_run and are not described as passed.
Boundary, session-policy and SCP conditional-deny fixtures reproduce the old behavior and return conditional after repair.
A definitely applicable unconditional deny remains blocked; missing controlling inputs cannot become feasible.
Unsupported policy constructs and case-sensitive resource identifiers are exercised and conservatively handled within declared support.
The API, change review, aftermath and MCP expose consistent decision and evidence, without changing frozen evaluation records.
Budget exhaustion, a null coverage result, a failed page and zero configured observers each remain partial/unknown and cannot imply visibility.
A decisive event beyond the first 100 results is retrieved or explicitly outstanding; no silent completion.
Same raw actor/session/run IDs under unrelated authorities do not support a joint hypothesis.
Failed logins followed by success and benign activity never alone establish malicious guessing; allowed tool calls never alone establish approval.
Existing synthetic/live examples remain valid or receive an explicit tested versioned migration; no silent semantic relabeling.
Local recorded activity always exposes synthetic-data and local-scope qualifiers in API/UI/MCP/export.
Every new contract rejects unknown executable, credential and arbitrary-target fields.
Capability badges derive from scoped receipts, not from a surface family name or an LLM declaration.
An empty workspace can preview all three templates without provider credentials.
Untrusted Compose/OpenAPI/manifest strings are treated as data; scripts, interpolation, remote refs and executable assets are rejected or ignored explicitly.
Same blueprint version/seed yields the same logical graph and layout proposal; changed input yields a new revision.
Adding a service preserves unrelated identities and coordinates; ambiguous routes stay ambiguous.
A different localhost service, redirect, metadata/LAN/public address or unregistered endpoint is refused before action.
A run token cannot reach another run or a non-lab project; forged environment labels do not grant authority.
Stopping/aborting cleans only manifest-owned resources and records cleanup failure without removing user files.
Frozen scenario time cannot suspend wall-clock limits; resource and network controls are checked or the execution mode is explicitly restricted/refused.
A real local request reaches the expected service and appears identically in API, browser and MCP evidence.
A permitted operation and a prohibited operation produce independently observed outcomes under the current policy.
A deliberate observer outage becomes unknown for the affected interval, not a no-effect conclusion.
Every source has independent declared authority; relayed/self-reported records cannot corroborate themselves.
DSL cannot execute scripts, shell, plugins or unrestricted network requests.
Same seed/action schedule reproduces intended state; runtime timing differences are recorded, not hidden.
Missing/delayed/dropped evidence affects observability without rewriting private operation truth.
Investigator views contain no answer labels, hidden seeds, expected action IDs or oracle credentials.
Contracts derive from public case scope and supported recipes, never private scenario truth.
An obligation is satisfied only by the required scoped evidence or a documented inapplicability reason.
An incomplete investigation can honestly conclude unresolved without asserting a negative or malicious intent.
Changing scope or evidence invalidates affected obligations without overwriting previous decisions.
A key event beyond page one is fetched under a stable snapshot without duplicate/skip at tied timestamps.
No tool accepts raw SQL, arbitrary paths, unrestricted graph queries or source credentials.
Restart resumes from committed job state; cancellation/revocation stops further authorized work.
Budget/truncation/error states remain explicit and do not mark downstream obligations satisfied.
A summary never substitutes for a missing required record; packet omissions are machine-readable.
Citations to existing but not retrieved records fail availability checks; cross-run/revision refs fail scope checks.
Arbitrary natural-language support is not labeled machine-proved merely because IDs exist.
Counterevidence, source uncertainty and partial query status survive packet size limits and exports.
Both profiles receive only permitted project/run evidence and the same records as the UI.
Case/job writes have correct annotations and backend privileges; viewer cannot persist a change by calling a nominal read tool.
Prompt text in an event/tool result cannot change profile, budget, target or approval policy.
Tool outputs are bounded with resumable refs; disconnected clients can resume without hidden extra model calls.
Changing cases aborts stale reads and preserves unsaved drafts in the correct scope.
A user can reach supporting/counterevidence, failed queries and uncertainty without navigating a 3D camera.
Agent completion cannot silently resolve an unanswered case question or erase a person’s note.
Keyboard/reduced-motion/narrow-screen automated workflows retain the same critical evidence and status.
Conditional permission never animates as observed use; unsupported provider semantics remain unresolved.
A proposed candidate cannot modify baseline facts, findings, scenes or approval receipts.
Same-name resources/versions under different authorities remain distinct throughout a comparison.
A comparison records the exact state, policy version, conditions and unassessed paths.
At least two valid candidates or an explicit no-supported-repair result are returned for applicable scenarios.
Ranking records objective coverage, disruption, prerequisites and unknowns; it does not claim global optimality.
A patch cannot execute evidence instructions, write the operator checkout or publish a PR.
A stale baseline/candidate digest prevents old approval from authorizing a changed repair.
Repeated source retries do not create a notification storm or discard the underlying case event.
Acknowledging a queue item never closes a finding or case implicitly.
Notifications contain scoped minimized summaries and never expose another project’s details.
The workflow works with every remote destination disabled and no outbound notification call.
Adding a service preserves unrelated coordinates; intentional reflow is previewed and versioned.
Removed/recreated resources resolve to their own incarnation and historical location.
Every aggregated district retains a complete accessible membership list and asset search.
WebGL loss, resize, back navigation and selection changes retain the case and evidence scope.
Every family has a readable unique silhouette and in-bounds geometry at supported LOD; no placeholder cube is counted as finished art.
Roof-off and selection proxies work at overview and interior scales without intercepting unrelated clicks.
Geometry/material/manifest hashes and licenses are recorded; no user font files are distributed in handoff exports.
Rendered families do not imply discovery or control verification; unsupported surfaces display honest capability state.
Selecting an interior object opens the exact authoritative record and its provenance, not a generated description alone.
Declared doors/grants are not drawn as observed attacker transit; status is never color-only.
Agent decisions, executions and effects remain distinct and link to their independent evidence.
The same workflow and selected IDs survive 3D/2D/list switching and narrow-screen use.
Creating or viewing a branch does not change baseline state or current source coverage.
Removed/added/changed authority is visible with exact references and unresolved conditions.
A simulated blocked path never appears as a verified executed control.
Comparison export identifies both revisions and preserves incomplete/changed evidence warnings.
An investigator/service token cannot issue, extend or approve its own lease.
Lease targets are supervisor-owned resources; forged lab metadata or a real provider ARN is refused.
Expired/stale/replayed approval or changed parameters cannot authorize execution.
A local lease never counts as human approval and cannot authorize the existing production-facing response path.
An approved local plan changes only the exact registered target revision and records an effect receipt.
Crash after application but before receipt is reconciled without applying the change twice.
Shell commands, arbitrary endpoints, host paths and production adapter requests are rejected.
Cancellation, quota, partial failure and cleanup are surfaced; original compromised authority is not restored as rollback.
An accepted action with unchanged target behavior fails verification.
Delayed and unrelated concurrent effects are correlated correctly; unavailable observer yields inconclusive.
Prohibited behavior blocked while legitimate behavior broken cannot be a verified repair.
Cleanup failure remains visible and prevents whole-run success even when the security assertion passed.
A regression reruns without an LLM and reproduces the supported boundary result.
Changing a relevant policy/tool/artifact version marks the old validation stale.
No secret, private oracle, arbitrary executable or unrelated record is exported in the descriptor.
Closing a case requires scoped answers/accepted unknowns; a failed verification cannot silently close it.
A real stdio client can investigate the local world through normal authenticated endpoints.
No provider route is silently selected; missing model availability remains not_exercised for AI-specific checks.
A native coding agent with repo/oracle access is labeled development_assisted, not held-out blinded.
Captured traces include observable tool I/O and claims, not hidden model reasoning or tokens.
Investigator attempts to read oracle paths, seed/config keys and scoring endpoints are denied and recorded.
Grading uses actual controlled operations/state, not the same detector/helper whose output is being tested.
The answer key accepts uncertainty when decisive facts are unobservable; it never demands omniscience.
Renaming resources or changing nuisance fields does not leak the answer or change a logically equivalent objective.
All conditions pass evidence-access/metadata equality before attempts; invalid preflight is not a model score.
Missing reachable evidence counts against retrieval and end-to-end success; no outcome is inferred by subtracting automatic failures.
Structured task/repair predicates, semantic critique and coverage limitations use separate denominators.
No prior $5 budget or historical approval is reused; remote paid mode requires an explicit new route, cap and pre-reservation.
Removing a denial, skipping a required page or substituting a model refusal makes the corresponding test fail.
Clean/injected pairs differ only in the intended field and are compared against clean-repeat variability.
No scenario launches external scans, malware, arbitrary shell or real credential collection.
Errors, partial runs, observer outages and budget exhaustion remain in the run/accounting records.
Round-trip retains exact supported evidence references and explicitly reports absent records.
Zip-slip, absolute paths, links, oversized entries, decompression bombs and unsupported executables are rejected before extraction.
Evidence-only exports exclude oracle data, tokens, secrets, provider credentials and private font files.
Hash/signature validation is described as integrity/origin checking, not proof of truth, completeness or independent approval.
An operator creates, previews, runs and reopens a supported local mission without editing source.
Builder and investigator views are distinct; opening truth explicitly taints the run as non-blinded.
Invalid plans keep drafts and do not create partial resources or fabricated connected status.
Local-only operation is obvious throughout UI/MCP/export; remote setup is not a prerequisite.
Existing tests still pass or changes have a versioned reason and retained old evidence; no weakened assertions for green CI.
Repeated start/reset/project/camera/case cycles are bounded under recorded conditions and failed cleanup is surfaced.
Real rendered screenshots and browser interactions cover new families, interiors, branches and failure states.
Claims stay scoped to tested hardware/software; manual screen-reader, physical GPU and external-use acceptance remain deferred.
An end-to-end scripted run covers launch, incident, investigation, repair, verification and export on the same candidate.
An actually available approved AI route exercises the loop or AI status remains explicitly not_exercised without blocking truthful scripted completion.
All phase requirements have receipts or explicit reasons; external deferred items are never silently approved.
No unauthorized repository merge/deployment/provider call occurred; handoff names precise next work instead of declaring universal readiness.
